config.note: DewPad only draws. It never changes what a button does. A change to the controller style shows the next time a controller screen opens.
config.enabled.name: Enable DewPad
config.enabled.tooltip: Turns the hints and the icon change off completely.
config.style.name: Button style
config.style.tooltip: Which buttons to show. Auto shows PlayStation or Switch when your pad's name says so, the Steam Deck's own labels on a Steam Deck, and Xbox otherwise. A pad that Steam Input or a driver presents as an Xbox pad shows as Xbox, so pick the layout here if that is you.
config.switch.name: Switch button labels
config.switch.tooltip: Only for the Switch style. The game's art shows Check as the Switch A. Position keeps every button where it sits, so the bottom button shows as the Switch B.
config.prompts.name: Show button hints
config.prompts.tooltip: Shows what the buttons do along the bottom of the game menu, chests and shops, while a controller is in use.
config.scale.name: Hint size
config.scale.tooltip: Size of the hints. 1 is the normal size.
config.icons.name: Use the style in the game's controller screens
config.icons.tooltip: Shows the chosen layout in the controls tutorial, the fishing and arcade help and the button icons. The game already has this art, and only draws the Xbox one.
